description: This PHP source file defines the class QuickCreateMetaParser, which extends MetaParser, and provides functionality for parsing HTML files (specifically pre-5.0 SugarCRM QuickCreate.html files) to produce a metadata array structure. It includes detailed parsing logic to extract form elements, slots, labels, and buttons, and constructs a metadata array for use in SugarCRM/ SuiteCRM.

classes.name: QuickCreateMetaParser
classes.description: A parser class extending MetaParser, specialized in parsing SugarCRM pre-5.0 QuickCreate HTML files, extracting form structure, and converting it into the corresponding metadata array.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that sets the view to 'QuickCreate'.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method that reads HTML content from a file, manipulates it to extract form elements, rows, and columns, and builds a metadata array representing the form structure, including buttons, hidden inputs, and layout panels.
